test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The erroneous spelling is **'Suspecious'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling for the word is ***suspicious ***which means having or showing a cautious distrust of someone or something.

 
 
• **Example - ***He was **suspicious **of her motives. *
 
 
 
• The meanings of the other options are as follows - 
 
 
• **Possession - **the state of having, owning, or controlling something. - *She had taken **possession **of the house.*
 
• **Jealous - **feeling or showing an envious resentment of someone or their achievements, possessions, or perceived advantages. - *He was always **jealous **of his brother. *
 
• **Luxurious - **extremely comfortable or elegant, especially when involving great expense. - *These rooms are very **luxurious. ***
 
 
 
• Hence, **option 3 **is the correct answer.
